delivery.en: Carriers serve Guam, but mainland Priority Mail can take several days and Ground far longer
delivery.zh: 可送到關島，但從美國本土寄的 Priority 可能要好幾天，Ground 更久

readback.en: After 671, numbers go 3-3-4; 0 as zero or oh; US dollars; month first; 12-hour a.m./p.m.
readback.zh: 671 區碼後照 3-3-4 唸，0 可唸 zero 或 oh；美元；先月後日；12 時制

fraud.en: A call or text pushing a link or a payment, including a fake USPS delivery notice, is a scam
fraud.zh: 來電或簡訊催你點連結、付錢，包括假冒 USPS 的投遞通知，都是詐騙

habits.en: Reply in English. People may say Hafa adai, which is unsupported. Month first, zip codes, US dollars.
habits.zh: 用英語回。有人會順口說 Hafa adai，但不在支援清單。日期先月後日，有 zip code，貨幣美元。

stall_local.en: Mainland tracking has not updated, which is common on Guam routes, and the home Wi-Fi just dropped.
stall_local.zh: 從本土寄來的查件一直沒更新，關島航線常見，而且家裡 Wi-Fi 剛好斷了。

reason.zh: 英式說法；關島用 zip code
加勒比貨幣，關島用美元
英式住宅詞，當地較常說 apartment

talk_style_diff.en: Largely US English, with a possible Hafa adai in passing. Do not pretend to speak Chamorro. Allow slower island USPS times; refuse fake delivery links.
talk_style_diff.zh: 大致是美式英語，對方或順口說 Hafa adai。不要假裝會講查莫羅語。接受島嶼郵務較慢，但拒絕假投遞連結。

uncertain: Hafa adai 是否常用來接電話，還是多半用於見面，沒有通話調查。
關島本地特有詐騙話術，官方稿寫得較概括，故同時引用 USPS 防詐。
